title: Sources: Anthropic has begun weighing a new funding round at a $900B+ valuation, after previously resisting investor proposals at an $800B+ valuation (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic has begun weighing a new funding round at a $900B+ valuation, after previously resisting investor proposals at an $800B+ valuation — Anthropic PBC has begun weighing a fresh funding round that would value the artificial intelligence developer at more than $900 billion …
